action: SAP administrators: apply SAP Notes 3778530, 3778556, 3798345 and 3849308 as a priority. All four flaws are rated 10.0 and need no login. Cover every Web Dispatcher and Gateway instance and any AS ABAP system using SAML2 logon.
exec: Four maximum-severity flaws in core SAP components are confirmed by SAP's own records; prompt patching is warranted.
plain: SAP's monthly security release includes four flaws given the highest possible severity score. SAP's own records confirm an attacker needs no login to use them. Fixes are available.

key_findings: SAP's own CVE records rate four flaws CVSS 10.0, each exploitable over the network without authentication or user interaction.
CVE-2026-76964 (NetWeaver AS ABAP Internet Communication Manager) and CVE-2026-89126 (Web Dispatcher) are memory corruption from crafted network traffic that could give code execution.
CVE-2026-89103: SAP Gateway turns on a high-privilege default access control list that can treat an outside attacker as an internal application server.
CVE-2026-120017: under certain configurations the SAML2 service provider does not properly verify assertions, letting an attacker impersonate any user including privileged ones.
Affected kernels span 7.53 to 9.20 for ICM and Web Dispatcher, 7.22 to 9.21 for Gateway, and SAP_BASIS 702 to 922 for SAML2.
report.publisher: SAP (CVE records published by SAP as CVE numbering authority)
recommendations: Apply SAP Note 3778530 (NetWeaver AS ABAP ICM) and SAP Note 3778556 (Web Dispatcher).
Apply SAP Note 3849308 (SAML2 service provider in AS ABAP and ABAP Platform).

summary: SAP's November 10 CVE records confirm four flaws rated CVSS 10.0: memory corruption in the NetWeaver AS ABAP Internet Communication Manager and in Web Dispatcher, a SAP Gateway default access list that can treat outsiders as internal servers, and a SAML2 assertion check failure allowing impersonation of any user. Each is fixed by its own SAP Note. The 35-note total comes from secondary coverage.
title: SAP Patch Day: 35 notes, four rated CVSS 10.0
